stages.name: Current compatibility/oracle mode

owners.IGraphicsSystem: Pinned ReXGlue runtime plus the loaded rexgpu-xenos.dll provider.
owners.guest_ring_processing: ReXGlue xenos CommandProcessor on the GPU Commands host thread.
owners.register_state: The single ReXGlue xenos RegisterFile and D3D12 command processor.
owners.memory_callbacks: ReXGlue Kernel Memory/PhysicalHeap and graphics SharedMemory.
owners.interrupts: ReXGlue graphics system and guest interrupt callback registered by the TU1 lifecycle path.
owners.vblank: ReXGlue GPU VSync host thread and guest-visible vblank counters/events.
owners.command_submission: D3D12CommandProcessor and its command lists, queues, fences, pipeline workers and caches.
owners.host_ui: ReXApp, ImGuiDrawer, UIDrawers and ReXGlue XAM dialogs/achievement notifications.
owners.shutdown: TU1 Xbox graphics lifecycle calls plus ReXGlue graphics/provider/presenter shutdown ordering.

stages.rexgpu_xenos_role: Required and authoritative compatibility renderer/oracle. No mirror, bypass or second consumer exists.
stages.semantic_layer_controlled: The title emits its original Xbox D3D/XDK/Vd behavior; this project controls only static documentation and may later wrap a proven title function while always forwarding.
stages.fallback_without_dual_ownership: All operations remain unchanged and execute only through rexgpu-xenos.dll. There is no native fallback path in this stage.
entry_gate: Already satisfied by the exact pinned Fable, ReXGlue and active DLL identities.
Any observation must be separately authorized, default-off and fail-open.
unproven: No renderer replacement seam or ownership transition exists.

stages.name: Hybrid observation and incremental replacement mode

owners.IGraphicsSystem: ReXGlue/rexgpu-xenos remains the sole production IGraphicsSystem owner during observation.
owners.guest_ring_processing: ReXGlue remains the sole guest-ring consumer; shadow/title records must not consume or mutate the ring.
owners.register_state: ReXGlue retains the sole mutable register file; observations may snapshot minimal fields only.
owners.memory_callbacks: ReXGlue retains the sole watch, validity, upload, readback and guest-memory visibility owner.
owners.command_submission: ReXGlue retains sole production command submission ownership.
owners.presenter: ReXGlue retains the sole swap-chain/presenter owner.
owners.host_ui: ReXGlue continues composing UIDrawers after guest output.
owners.shutdown: ReXGlue remains the sole graphics and presentation shutdown owner.

stages.rexgpu_xenos_role: Required as unchanged oracle during evidence acquisition. It may be observed or correlated, never mirrored as a second ring/render owner.
stages.semantic_layer_controlled: Proven title-level Xbox D3D/XDK wrappers may emit optional metadata or a normalized shadow description while their preserved original bodies execute exactly once.
stages.fallback_without_dual_ownership: Unknown or unimplemented title operations always take the preserved original path before any native side effect. Initial Stage B is observation-only. The pinned sources do not prove a way to mix native draws into the oracle output without double rendering or resource/presenter ownership.
entry_gate: Recover at least one representative TU1 draw/resource/shader/target method with exact ABI, threading, ownership and coverage evidence.
Complete linked exact-once forwarding proof for any wrapper used.
Define bounded metadata schemas and ignored output paths.
Before incremental rendering, prove a single-owner output/resource integration interface that is not present in the current corpus.
unproven: A viable incremental rendering ownership transition is not proved.
ReXGlue exposes no composable dual-GPU ABI in the pinned source.
Optional normalized title-specific IR remains a hypothesis until static XDK method recovery.

stages.name: Eventual title-specific native-renderer mode

owners.IGraphicsSystem: UNDECIDED: either one future compatible graphics provider owns the full required contract, or a separately validated ReXGlue integration interface retains non-rendering GPU services. The pinned corpus proves neither model.
owners.guest_ring_processing: Exactly one owner is mandatory. It may remain a compatibility service or be intentionally retired only after complete title-operation coverage and service replacement proof.
owners.register_state: Exactly one authoritative guest-state owner or a proved retirement mapping; no shadow state may become independently mutable.
owners.memory_callbacks: ReXGlue services remain required unless a replacement proves identical guest memory visibility, watches, upload/readback and invalidation behavior.
owners.interrupts: ReXGlue ownership remains required until an equivalent guest interrupt contract is demonstrated.
owners.vblank: ReXGlue ownership remains required until equivalent guest vblank timing/counters/events are demonstrated.
owners.command_submission: One native backend submission owner selected only after packet/order/query/resource semantics are qualified.
owners.presenter: One guest-output mailbox and swap-chain owner. A future renderer may feed the ReXGlue presenter only if a stable producer interface is proved.
owners.host_ui: ReXGlue host UI contract remains after guest output unless deliberately reimplemented with compatible focus, async completion, persistence, z-order and cancellation.
owners.shutdown: One ordered owner must cancel/retire GPU, presenter and UI work without duplicate teardown.

stages.rexgpu_xenos_role: Retained as oracle until replacement evidence is complete. Eventually replaceable only if one validated integration model covers every still-required GPU/runtime service; it is not assumed removable.
stages.semantic_layer_controlled: Preferred target is recovered Fable/Lionhead intent or static Xbox D3D/XDK operations, optionally normalized into backend-neutral title IR before D3D12 capability choices.
stages.fallback_without_dual_ownership: There is no proved per-operation native/oracle composition path. Entry requires a fail-closed coverage proof or an explicit single-owner handoff; otherwise Stage A remains active.
entry_gate: Representative methods expand to demonstrably complete operation and lifecycle coverage for the chosen gameplay scope.
Resource/shader identity, ordering, queries, vblank, interrupts, memory visibility, mailbox and UI contracts have controlled evidence.
A single-owner integration interface is present and tested.
L5 controlled evidence exists for renderer-critical divergences selected by the affected scene.
unproven: Whether the eventual renderer can avoid the complete GPU ABI.
Whether ReXGlue can retain guest GPU services while a title renderer owns output.
Whether a normalized IR is necessary or sufficient.
Whether any existing G1 candidate covers all renderer operations.

seam_decisions.name: ReXGlue GPU ABI version 1 / IGraphicsSystem provider
evidence: The exact active rexgpu-xenos.dll is loaded and initializes D3D12.
Pinned ReXGlue assigns ring, registers, memory callbacks, interrupts, vblank, submissions and presentation to this graphics system.
limitations: Using the raw ABI as the primary title renderer seam would require emulator-scale Xenos behavior.
The ABI is mandatory for the currently deployed path but does not prove it must be the eventual renderer's semantic interface.
seam_decisions.fallback: All current and unimplemented operations remain on this sole oracle path.

seam_decisions.name: Recovered static Xbox D3D/XDK operations
evidence: G1 proved title-side Xbox graphics lifecycle and swap functions around 0x82B6EA60..0x82BA6EB8.
Static XDK operations should retain more resource/state/draw meaning than PM4 or D3D12 internals.
limitations: Representative draw/resource/shader/target methods are not identified.
Coverage, ABI, threading and ownership are unproved.
seam_decisions.fallback: Until a method is proved, execute the original TU1 path unchanged.

seam_decisions.name: Lionhead async layer around sub_82AAC208
evidence: The ProcessAsyncCommandQueues label and exact TU1 body support a strong discovery hypothesis.
limitations: Queue ABI, producer/consumer threading, ownership, recursion and operation coverage are not proved.
No direct generated caller is known.
seam_decisions.fallback: Discovery only; do not wrap until ABI proof.

seam_decisions.name: sub_82BA34D8 title swap-command emitter
evidence: Exact TU1 range [0x82BA34D8, 0x82BA3BFC), size 0x724, 457 PPC instructions.
Paused G2A preserves a distinct __imp__sub_82BA34D8 body.
limitations: No draw, shader, texture, register, EDRAM or resource-lifetime provenance remains.
A linked production exact-once proof is absent.
seam_decisions.fallback: Preserved original body executes exactly once; otherwise no hook.

seam_decisions.name: ReXGlue command/draw/resource observation surfaces
evidence: IssueDraw, ConfigurePipeline, RequestTextures, Resolve and SharedMemory surfaces expose discriminating low-level state.
limitations: They have already lost Fable/Lionhead intent.
They are internal owners with side effects and cannot be promoted to replacement seams by observation value alone.
seam_decisions.fallback: Read minimal metadata while the unchanged oracle remains sole owner.

seam_decisions.name: Guest-output mailbox, UIDrawer composition and host Present
evidence: Pinned D3D12 source composes guest output before host UIDrawers and then DXGI Present.
Run 047 proves Fable keyboard and achievement host-UI routes execute.
limitations: The presenter is too late to diagnose guest draw/resource defects.
A future guest-output producer interface is not proved.
seam_decisions.fallback: Retain the ReXGlue presenter and UI ordering until an equivalent single-owner contract exists.

seam_decisions.name: Optional normalized title-specific renderer IR
evidence: A backend-neutral layer could separate guest semantics from D3D12 capability choices.
limitations: No recovered operation set exists from which to derive the IR.
IR does not itself solve ownership, fallback, ordering, queries or presentation.
seam_decisions.fallback: Do not create an IR until static method recovery demonstrates repeated stable semantics.

ownership_transition_conclusion.finding: The corpus proves current single ownership and useful complementary high-level/low-level evidence surfaces, but it does not prove a composable incremental renderer transition.
ownership_transition_conclusion.missing_interface: Pinned ReXGlue provides no demonstrated interface for a title renderer and rexgpu-xenos.dll to share ring consumption, register/resource ownership, rendering output or the presenter without double work.
ownership_transition_conclusion.decision_gate: Recover representative static XDK methods first, then prove one explicit single-owner integration model before any renderer implementation.
